annotations.text:
Phase 3 native windows. Palette and type from Theme.ahk (the paste-mode card). Every artboard has a Dark switch and an Accent swatch in its tweak row: flip them to see the light theme or another Windows accent.
Win32 limits: GroupBoxes become section headers, the Hotkey control becomes a click-to-record field, spinners are Edit + two small buttons.

Settings: left nav, one page per topic, 8px grid, min 720×520 and resizable. Apply enables only after a change (shown enabled on the Appearance page).
New in 13.0: the Appearance page (theme, notification position, pinned card position) and the private-clips switch under General.
Small dialogs keep their behavior; they only pick up the theme, Segoe UI and consistent button rows. Ignored Windows moves in-process so adding a class no longer restarts Clipjump.
